exposure: nifedipine and ML7 co-loaded nanofibers (various concentrations)
cohort: Uterine tissue samples were obtained from ten pregnant women who underwent cesarean section at term.
finding: The administration of drug-loaded nanofibers significantly decreased the frequency and intensity of spontaneous and induced uterine contractions, with the most significant inhibition observed when ML7 and nifedipine were co-loaded at doses of 3x10-5 M and 10-4 M, respectively.
